# User-count route {.unnumbered}

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {"themeVariables": {"fontSize": "20px"}}}%%
flowchart TD
  S[(Geographic donors)]
  T2[Tab 2 provides<br/>REF/CF users by mode]
  E[Estimate total population<br/>and trips per mode]
  T3[Tab 3 displays and refines<br/>people and users]
  P[(Final person/user counts)]
  T4[Tab 4 starts with trips estimated<br/>from final users]

  S --> T2
  T2 -->|user counts are authoritative initially| E
  E -->|prepopulate| T3
  T3 -->|last displayed counts prevail| P
  P --> T4
```

# Trip-count route {.unnumbered}

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {"themeVariables": {"fontSize": "20px"}}}%%
flowchart TD
  S[(Geographic donors)]
  T2[Tab 2 provides<br/>REF/CF trips by mode]
  E[Estimate users and<br/>total population]
  T3[Tab 3 displays and refines<br/>people and users]
  P[(Final person/user counts)]
  T4[Tab 4 starts with exact<br/>Tab 2 trip targets]

  S --> T2
  T2 -->|trip counts remain authoritative| E
  E -->|prepopulate people| T3
  T3 -->|refine allocation, not trips| P
  T2 -->|carry trip targets unchanged| T4
  P -->|allocate trips across fixed users| T4
```

\newpage

# Distance/duration route {.unnumbered}

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {"themeVariables": {"fontSize": "20px"}}}%%
flowchart TD
  S[(Geographic donors)]
  T2[Tab 2 provides REF/CF<br/>distance or duration]
  C[Divide by reference mean<br/>amount per trip]
  Q[Derived per-mode<br/>trip targets]
  T3[Estimate and refine<br/>people and users]
  T4[Tab 4 starts with<br/>derived trip targets]

  S -->|reference trip patterns| C
  T2 --> C
  C --> Q
  Q --> T3
  Q --> T4
  T3 -->|fixed person/user counts| T4
```

The original kilometres or minutes explain how the starting trip targets were
derived. After Tab 4 changes, the final aggregate is measured from the sample.

\newpage

# Mode-share route {.unnumbered}

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {"themeVariables": {"fontSize": "20px"}}}%%
flowchart TD
  S[(Geographic donors)]
  T2[Tab 2 provides REF/CF<br/>mode shares + denominator]
  C[Multiply shares by total trips<br/>or convert distance/duration]
  Q[Derived per-mode<br/>trip targets]
  T3[Estimate and refine<br/>people and users]
  T4[Tab 4 starts with<br/>derived trip targets]

  S -->|reference conversion assumptions| C
  T2 --> C
  C --> Q
  Q --> T3
  Q --> T4
  T3 -->|fixed person/user counts| T4
```

\newpage

# Shared Tab 3-to-results handoff {.unnumbered}

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {"themeVariables": {"fontSize": "20px"}}}%%
flowchart TD
  T3[Last displayed Tab 3 table]
  P[(Fixed total population<br/>and users by mode)]
  T4[Last displayed Tab 4 table]
  Q[(Final trips by mode)]
  A{Enough observed trips<br/>owned by final users?}
  O[Use observed eligible rows]
  D[Sample donor patterns with replacement<br/>and assign to fixed users]
  H[Calculate MMET changes<br/>and health impacts]
  R[Tab 5 results and exports]

  T3 --> P
  T4 --> Q
  P --> A
  Q --> A
  A -->|yes| O
  A -->|no| D
  O --> H
  D -->|warn and audit| H
  H --> R
```
